B.name: Shemaiah
B.line: Priest who returned from exile with Zerubbabel, head of a priestly house

kjv.NEH 12:18: Of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;

disputed_verses.KJV NEH 12:18: Of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;

first_reader_said: NEH 12:18: Both records are Shemaiah, ancestor of Jehonathan in the list of priestly houses.
NEH 12:6: Both records are the priest Shemaiah, ancestor of Jehonathan (12:18), whose house stands in the Zerubbabel list.

why: B is the priest of Zerubbabel's returning generation in NEH 12:6, whereas A is identified with the later covenant signatory in NEH 10:8. NEH 12:18 names Shemaiah's priestly house, represented by Jehonathan; this shared house association does not establish that the earlier ancestor and later signatory were one man. A also includes the musician Shemaiah among Maai's brethren in NEH 12:36, indicating additional conflation rather than reliable evidence for merging. NEH 12:6 and NEH 12:18 on A belong to B.
